input.explanation: No. The whole fix is in src/io_shop/visits.py. `record_visit` now keeps at most `_MOST_SHOPPERS_REMEMBERED` entries and drops the longest-absent ones. Its signature is unchanged, so `account_page.py`, the only caller, needs no change, and nothing outside this repository needs to change either. Once this is deployed, the process's visit store stays bounded however many distinct shoppers come by.
